set.body: On the V2 fixture candidate, implement standalone eyes4s and pinned pymovements ASC adapters that materialize the entire binocular sample table with time_us, eye, x_px, y_px, pupil and status. Normalize the native zero-pupil gap marker to explicit lost/null canonical rows and verify parsed message/eye metadata. Prove byte-identical canonical output and expected counts on small/typical/large. This is correctness preflight only; the timed collector and native artifact receipts remain PM3.4 work.
